brief:
Israeli military operations have killed 8,948 people and wounded 30,638 others across Lebanon, according to Shehab Wire. The casualty toll reflects what the agency characterizes as continuous Israeli military aggression targeting the country over an unspecified period.

The figures represent a significant escalation in the human cost of the conflict. The deaths and injuries span civilian and other categories, though specific breakdowns by location, date range, or civilian status were not detailed in the available reporting.

title: Israeli strikes kill 8,948 in Lebanon, wound 30,638
